item.title: BloomTale
item.description:
Title: BloomTale
Genre: Casual
Developer: Floralia Games
Publisher: Floralia Games
Release Date: Oct 23, 2026




About This Game

Step into the world of BloomTale , where your creativity blossoms as you run your very own flower shop. Each flower carries a unique meaning, and your mission is to master the language of flowers by crafting thoughtful arrangements that reflect your customers’ feelings. Tend to your blooms, customize your shop, and watch your reputation grow and flourish with every bouquet.

Features

Flowers are more than just decoration. Each bloom carries its own meaning, letting you craft bouquets that symbolize love, hope, apology, or even luck. Mix and match flowers, colors, wraps, ribbons, and decorations to create arrangements with a truly personal touch.

Meet over 15 unique customers, each with their own story and a little bit of whimsy. Pick flowers or craft bouquets to match their requests and enjoy watching their personalities grow with each visit.

As your shop grows, so does the world around it. Unlock visual upgrades, personalize your home, and create a space that matches your style.

Unlock over 50 unique flowers, each with its own meaning, and fill your magical garden with vibrant blooms. Keep your garden happy and discover tiny visitors wandering among your flowers.

item.title: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
item.description:
Title: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
Genre: Casual , Simulation
Developer: Over The Moon Games
Publisher: Over The Moon Games
Release Date: Oct 23, 2026




About This Game

You expected a quiet little Halloween shop. You open the door to find its contents scattered everywhere. Time to put things right—and perhaps find out what happened.

An armful at a time

Pick up scattered treasures and return them to their shelves. From curious potions and tiny familiars to pumpkins, sweets and autumn flowers, there’s a whole shop of spooky little things to sort. Enjoy the satisfaction of everything finding its place, at your own pace.

A little out of the ordinary

Some things need more than tidying away. Follow strange clues, discover the shop’s secrets, and find a friend who may know something about the mess.

Settle in. There’s no timer, and you might have company.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We use generative AI across all disciplines of game development, most often with heavy amounts of human editing. That involves audio and visual art, 3D models, our logo, and localization. We use it as a productivity tool so we can achieve a higher level of quality, faster, than we would have been able to.

We also have a full soundtrack of 1950's halloween pop hits that are obviously made by AI, as you can hear in the trailer. It's awesome and it'd be basically impossible otherwise.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 2200 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 2200 MB available space

item.title: Tape to Tape
item.description:
Title: Tape to Tape
Genre: Action , Sports
Developer: Excellent Rectangle
Publisher: Excellent Rectangle
Release Date: Oct 23, 2026
Early Access Release Date: May 3, 2023




About This Game

Explore a gorgeous roguelite hockey world where every choice matters on your journey to restore hockey to its former glory. Hire unique players, manage your benchwarmers, discover synergies between them, choose new abilities, bribe the referees, visit the Blademaster for upgrades and a lot more.

CRAFT YOUR TEAM

Take control of Angus McShaggy and lead your squad across a world filled with rival teams, strange characters and increasingly ridiculous challenges.

Hit the Training Center to boost your attributes, visit the No. 1 Fan to unlock a new player talent, or stop by the Infirmary to sacrifice a player... for the good of the team.

But this isn't a regular hockey season. Lose and your run is over. Start again, take a different route, build a different team using your new unlocks and discover new combinations along the way.

FACE TEAMS THAT DON'T PLAY BY THE RULES

Your opponents aren't interested in playing ordinary hockey. Take on cheating referees, farting princesses and the most sinister opponents of all: the Golfers.

Face teams with their own players, abilities, strategies and occasionally absurd interpretations of the rules. Learn how they play, adapt your strategy and figure out how to counter their strengths before they end your run.

MASTER EVERY SQUAD

Each Squad introduces its own twist on the game and can completely change how you approach a run.

Build your roster by hiring Free Agents with the GM Squad, embrace the physical side of hockey with the Violence Squad, go back to old-school hockey physics with the Retro Squad, or forget the wrist shot entirely and blast away with the Slapshot Squad.

DEEP AND REWARDING GAMEPLAY

Tape to Tape combines fast-paced arcade hockey with responsive controls, big hits, one-timers, saucer passes, desperate saves and plenty of opportunities to send your opponents flying.

Easy to pick up but with plenty to master, the game rewards good positioning, passing, timing and learning how to take advantage of your team's strengths.

KEY FEATURES

  • A hockey roguelite campaign where every run brings a new path, opponents, events and opportunities to build your team

  • All the replayability and progression of a roguelite, built around fast-paced arcade hockey

  • Face a colorful cast of unique rival teams, each with their own players, abilities and ridiculous ways of playing hockey

  • Experience the entire campaign solo or in local couch co-op

  • Fast, responsive arcade hockey featuring big hits, one-timers, saucer passes, dekes, rebounds and desperate saves

  • Keep coming back with persistent unlocks, including new players, abilities, Relics and Squads

  • Challenge your friends with up to 10 local players in Play Now, Tournament, Shootout and other game modes


LOCAL/STEAM REMOTE PLAY MULTIPLAYER

Note: Tape to Tape does not feature native online multiplayer. However, you can still play with friends remotely using Steam Remote Play Together or third-party services such as Parsec .

Experience the Roguelite Campaign at its best in co-op . Team up with friends to conquer the campaign, debate every power-up choice, and embrace the glorious chaos that makes each run unforgettable.

You can also jump into Play Now mode, where up to 10 players can face off locally. With a wide variety of teams, deep gameplay, and countless power-ups, every match feels chaotic, competitive, and endlessly replayable.

item.title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
item.description:
Title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
Genre: Adventure , RPG
Developer: Bamtang Games
Publisher: Trailmark Games
Release Date: Oct 23, 2026




About This Game

Forge your destiny, defend your Clan, and live the life of a true Warrior Cat.

Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series.

Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles.

Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

AN ORIGINAL STORY

Embark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise.

CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CAT

Using the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat.

GAME FEATURES:

* 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode.

Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life.

Defender mode - Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run.

Skirmish mode - Battle other players online asynchronously.

* Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations.

* 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island.

* Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles.

* 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock.

* Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series.

* Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more.

* Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey.

* Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously.

* You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials.

* No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.

item.title: Moon Sweepers
item.description:
Title: Moon Sweepers
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: DragDrop Games
Publisher: DragDrop Games
Release Date: Oct 23, 2026




About This Game

The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush.

Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time.

Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter.

Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries.

Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows.

Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used to assist with translating in-game text into supported languages.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
